title: P02 T11 fail-closed source security/privacy and PR merge-gate preparation
summary: Added source-based independent security/privacy contract tests and strict Windows CI audit for final M02/M19 P02 preview. Reviews original Tauri CSP, main-readonly privilege allowlist, typed Rust IPC scope/version/bounds, local-only Help and user-initiated report clipboard, absence of arbitrary network/browser storage/dynamic HTML/script injection, and untrusted PR workflow read-only permissions. Negative tests reject forged privilege expansion, external fetch and false T11 DONE. Reviewed outstanding inline PR comments; current source and tests prove each obsolete finding addressed; six review threads now resolved. This does not certify Narrator, all product states, hardware performance SLA, independent merge approval or release.
migration_notes: No changes to SQLite state, disk data, Rust privileges, user network connectivity or user files. Source-only CI regression and documentation. Rollback by reverting test/gate/doc commit.
